hooks.command: sh -c 'OPENSHARD_REPO_HOOK=1; grep -qs "openshard hooks claude" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/settings.local.json" && exit 0; OS=$(command -v openshard 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/openshard"); if [ -x "$OS" ]; then exec "$OS" hooks claude; fi; if { [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE:-}" = "true" ] || [ -n "${REPLICAS_WORKSPACE_ID:-}" ] || [ "${E2B_SANDBOX:-}" = "true" ] || [ "${OPENSHARD_REPO_BOOTSTRAP:-}" = "1" ]; } && [ "${OPENSHARD_REPO_BOOTSTRAP:-}" != "0" ] && mkdir "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/openshard-bootstrap" 2>/dev/null; then ( pipx install openshard >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip install --quiet openshard >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip install --quiet --user openshard >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip install --quiet --user --break-system-packages openshard >/dev/null 2>&1 ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo "openshard: installing in the background; events before it finishes are not captured" >&2; if [ -z "${OPENSHARD_REMOTE_TOKEN:-}" ] && [ -z "${OPENSHARD_CONNECTED_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "openshard: remote capture not linked; evidence stays in this environment" >&2; fi; exit 0; fi; echo "openshard: not installed; this event was not captured" >&2; exit 0'
